title: Causal Risk-Envelope Caching for Fast-WAM Optional-IDM
title_zh: 面向 Fast-WAM Optional-IDM 的因果风险包络缓存
hook: At the same cache-skip rate, units with similar hidden-state change can have very different paired action/video error because a small high-risk tail carries most of the downstream influence; a causal risk envelope should therefore refresh that tail and reuse the bulk. The predicted direction is lower paired downstream error than periodic or local-drift gating at matched skip rate while preserving closed-loop task success.
abstract_draft: Fast-WAM Optional-IDM must repeatedly process receding observations, yet caching an intermediate is risky because hidden-state change does not determine how much paired action and predicted-video output error reaches downstream descendants. C3ache shows that periodic cross-chunk reuse can reduce computation, but its cadence and task-success aggregate do not identify which cached units carry the downstream error. We propose Causal Risk-Envelope Caching (CREC), a training-free operator that replays stale-value interventions with the remaining Fast-WAM graph fixed, estimates a per-unit paired-output risk envelope conditioned on observation change, tests its heterogeneity against a unit-label permutation null, and refreshes the high-risk tail while reusing the bulk under a downstream error budget. The falsifiable prediction is lower held-out D_joint, action MSE, and predicted-observation MSE than periodic C3ache and a global local-drift gate at matched skip rates, without lowering closed-loop task success; envelope permutation should reverse this benefit. A minimum 2-A100 campaign, expandable to 4 A100, can test the claim on held-out LIBERO and RoboTwin with native GPU timing and the existing checkpoint. This is a validation target, not an observed result: if the heterogeneity gate or permutation control fails, latency alone does not support the causal risk-allocation claim.

motivation.problem_framing:
The Phase 1 bottleneck is not simply redundant computation. In Fast-WAM Optional-IDM, a changed receding observation can alter the influence of a cached unit through action and predicted-video branches, while units with similar hidden-state drift can have very different downstream consequences. A global local-drift threshold therefore treats the cache as exchangeable even when a small high-risk tail dominates paired error.

The proposed setting keeps the existing model and graph fixed and turns that asymmetry into a measurable object. C3ache supplies a useful periodic reuse reference, EfficientVLA supplies a feature-similarity reuse reference, and WorldCache and X-Cache show that heterogeneous or structure-aware caching can preserve rollout quality; none of these references, as represented in the scaffold, establishes a unit-level stale-value intervention whose paired action/video risk determines dependency-complete refresh. The question is consequently whether causal risk allocation, rather than another similarity score or cadence, is the missing operation.
motivation.why_now: Recent caching work makes the required measurement stack timely: C3ache provides a World-Action caching baseline, WorldCache exposes heterogeneous temporal behavior, and X-Cache provides structure- and action-aware reuse guards. DriveCache is an important boundary case because it already combines a scene-level dynamic-programming schedule, an action-aware response budget, and causal drift-triggered refresh/replan; CREC therefore makes no broad claim for action-aware budgeted caching. The remaining bounded question is whether Fast-WAM Optional-IDM has a distinct per-unit paired action/video risk envelope, a testable heterogeneity gate, and descendant-complete invalidation that can be evaluated with the existing checkpoint and native GPU timing.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: C3ache reuses same-denoising-step action-expert residuals on a periodic cross-chunk cadence to accelerate World-Action inference.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not estimate a per-unit paired action/video downstream-risk envelope from stale-value interventions or use that envelope to allocate refreshes.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its fixed cadence and aggregate task-success evaluation omit the causal intervention, heterogeneity test, and error-budgeted descendant recomputation needed for unit-level risk allocation.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: Fast-WAM studies whether test-time future imagination is needed for reliable world-action control with an Optional-IDM configuration.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not turn the fixed Fast-WAM graph into a cache-unit intervention platform with paired action/video risk estimates.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its question concerns the necessity of future imagination, not the missing measurement of stale intermediate influence under receding observations.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: EfficientVLA reuses attention and MLP intermediates in a CogACT action head using feature-similarity criteria without retraining.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not condition a paired action/video downstream-risk envelope on Fast-WAM receding-observation changes or validate a unit-label heterogeneity null.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Feature similarity is an input-side proxy, whereas the candidate requires intervention-based downstream measurement and dependency-aware refresh.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: The heterogeneous-token WorldCache uses curvature and accumulated drift to preserve video rollout quality while reusing non-uniform tokens.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not establish a paired action/video risk envelope for Fast-WAM units or test its tail against a unit-permutation control.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its quality-preserving object is heterogeneous video-token dynamics, not causal paired-output influence with an action branch and descendant invalidation.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: WorldCache uses content-aware reuse to accelerate video world-model rollouts while accounting for temporal variation.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not solve a Fast-WAM paired action/video error budget whose refresh decisions are indexed by intervened cache units.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: The video-rollout objective does not supply the action-coupled downstream measurement and dependency-complete recomputation required here.

why_prior_stopped.what_they_did: X-Cache gates cross-chunk block reuse with structure- and action-aware input fingerprints and KV-update guards.
why_prior_stopped.what_they_did_not_do: It did not calibrate a causal per-unit risk envelope or allocate refreshes under a paired downstream error budget with descendant invalidation.
why_prior_stopped.structural_reason_they_stopped: Its guard is a fingerprint and update rule, not an intervention that distinguishes heterogeneous causal influence from exchangeable drift.

motivation.what_changes_when_gap_closes: Fast-WAM caching would gain an explicit allocation object: refresh decisions could protect the empirically demonstrated high-risk tail while reusing the bulk at a fixed skip rate, instead of treating local drift as a sufficient proxy. This would make paired action/video error and closed-loop task success part of the cache validity boundary, complementing the reuse mechanisms of C3ache, EfficientVLA, and WorldCache without claiming to subsume DriveCache's scene-level controller. A successful gate would also provide a reusable causal diagnostic for deciding when a latency gain is mechanistically meaningful.

core_claim: A unit-specific causal risk envelope can identify a high-risk cache tail whose selective refresh lowers paired downstream action/video error at matched skip rate while preserving closed-loop task success.

sub_claims.statement: Stale-value replay reveals a non-exchangeable per-unit paired action/video risk tail after conditioning on receding-observation change.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: Closes the bottleneck that hidden-state drift alone cannot identify which cache units control downstream influence.

sub_claims.statement: Refreshing the risk-ranked tail and reusing the bulk under a downstream error budget reduces D_joint, action MSE, and predicted-observation MSE at matched skip rate.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: Closes the gap between a heterogeneous risk measurement and an actionable cache allocation rule.

sub_claims.statement: Permuting complete risk envelopes across cache units while preserving the risk budget and dependency logic degrades downstream outcomes, distinguishing causal allocation from a mere risk-score reshuffle.
sub_claims.supports_which_aspect: Closes the evidence gap between correlation with drift and a mechanism-specific refresh decision.

key_equations.description: The unit-specific envelope combines paired action and predicted-video downstream deviations at an observation-change level.
key_equations.description_zh: 单位级风险包络把动作分支与预测视频分支的下游偏差，按观测变化幅度联合起来。

key_equations.description: The refresh indicator minimizes recomputation cost while keeping the risk of reused units below the downstream budget.
key_equations.description_zh: 刷新指示变量在满足下游风险预算的同时，最小化重新计算的代价。

key_equations.description: The invalidation set contains every graph descendant of a refreshed unit so stale dependencies are not silently reused.
key_equations.description_zh: 失效集合覆盖所有被刷新单位的图后继，避免旧依赖在刷新后继续被静默复用。

method_flow.high_level_pipeline: CREC starts from held-out receding-observation replays of the existing Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph and replaces one cached unit-timestep with its stale value while holding the remaining graph fixed. It aggregates the paired action and predicted-video deviations into a unit-specific risk envelope, then requires the envelope distribution to reject a unit-label permutation null before using it for allocation. A binary refresh decision protects the high-risk tail under a downstream error budget and reuses the bulk at the requested skip rate. Every refresh invalidates graph descendants before the paired outputs are evaluated for error, native latency, and closed-loop task success.

steps.title: Replay stale units
steps.what_changes: For each cache unit and changed receding observation, substitute its cached value while keeping the remaining Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph fixed, and record paired action and predicted-video deviations.
steps.why_this_step: This closes the missing causal intervention: local hidden-state change is held separate from the downstream effect of one stale unit.
steps.input: Held-out receding-observation rollouts, cache-unit graph, and uncached reference outputs.
steps.output: Per-unit paired deviation samples indexed by observation-change level d.

steps.title: Gate on heterogeneity
steps.what_changes: Aggregate the paired samples into r_u(d) and compare the observed unit distribution with a unit-label permutation null that preserves the risk values and change levels.
steps.why_this_step: The proposal needs evidence that risk is genuinely heterogeneous; without this gate, a global drift rule and the proposed tail are not mechanistically distinguishable.
steps.input: Per-unit paired deviation samples from S1.
steps.output: Calibrated risk envelopes and a pass/fail heterogeneity evidence gate.

steps.title: Allocate the error budget
steps.what_changes: Solve the refresh-versus-reuse selection under a downstream error budget, refreshing the calibrated high-risk tail and reusing the remaining units at the matched skip rate.
steps.why_this_step: This converts the heterogeneous measurement into the candidate's load-bearing operation rather than another descriptive cache score.
steps.input: Passed risk envelopes, unit costs, dependency graph, and target risk budget or skip rate.
steps.output: Unit refresh indicators and a risk-budgeted cache schedule.

steps.title: Invalidate descendants
steps.what_changes: Refresh selected units, invalidate every graph descendant, recompute the paired action/video outputs, and measure downstream error, native GPU latency, and task success.
steps.why_this_step: Dependency-complete recomputation tests whether the allocation survives the actual Fast-WAM graph instead of only improving an isolated intermediate metric.
steps.input: Refresh indicators and dependency graph from S3, plus matched uncached and control rollouts.
steps.output: Paired downstream metrics, timing, task-success outcomes, and the envelope-permutation control result.

method_flow.design_reasoning_echo: The design treats caching as a causal allocation problem because the proposed failure mode is not uniform drift but concentrated downstream influence. Stale-value replay supplies the missing intervention while preserving the existing graph, the heterogeneity null prevents a convenient tail story from being accepted without evidence, and dependency-complete invalidation prevents an apparent local gain from hiding stale descendants. This is deliberately narrower than replacing the cache operator or training a learned policy: the contribution is a training-free risk object and its falsifiable refresh rule, with latency interpreted only together with paired error and task-success outcomes.

plain_motivation_en:
Fast-WAM Optional-IDM repeatedly processes new, receding observations. The problem is not merely repeated computation: changing an observation can make a cached unit affect both the action output and the predicted-video output, and two units with similar hidden-state drift can have very different downstream effects. A single local-drift threshold treats all units as interchangeable even when a small high-risk tail accounts for most paired error.

The proposed setting keeps the existing Fast-WAM model and graph fixed and measures this asymmetry directly. C3ache provides a periodic World-Action caching reference, EfficientVLA provides a feature-similarity reuse reference, and WorldCache and X-Cache show that heterogeneous or structure-aware reuse can preserve rollout quality. As represented here, none measures the downstream paired action/video risk of making one cache unit stale and uses that measurement to decide which dependencies must be refreshed. The question is therefore whether causal risk allocation, rather than another similarity score or fixed cadence, is the missing operation.

Recent caching work makes this measurement timely. C3ache, WorldCache, and X-Cache supply relevant reuse references, while DriveCache is a boundary case that already combines scene-level scheduling, an action-aware response budget, and causal drift-triggered refresh or replanning. CREC therefore makes no broad claim about action-aware budgeted caching. The bounded question is whether Fast-WAM Optional-IDM has a distinct per-unit paired action/video risk envelope, whether its heterogeneity can be tested, and whether descendant-complete invalidation can be evaluated with the existing checkpoint and native GPU timing.

If the gap is closed, Fast-WAM caching gains an explicit allocation object: at a fixed skip rate, it can refresh the empirically high-risk tail and reuse the bulk instead of treating local drift as sufficient. Paired action/video error and closed-loop task success become part of the cache validity boundary. A successful gate would also provide a reusable causal diagnostic for deciding when a latency gain is mechanistically meaningful, while complementing rather than claiming to subsume the cited reuse mechanisms.
plain_motivation_zh:
Fast-WAM Optional-IDM 会反复处理不断到来的观测。问题不只是重复计算：观测变化后，一个缓存单位可能同时影响动作输出和预测视频输出；两个单位即使隐藏状态漂移相近，它们对下游的影响也可能很不一样。单一的局部漂移阈值把所有单位当成可互换的对象，即使少数高风险单位已经承担了大部分动作与视频误差。

这个方案保持现有 Fast-WAM 模型和计算图不变，直接测量这种不对称性。C3ache 提供周期性 World-Action caching 参考，EfficientVLA 提供基于特征相似度的复用参考，WorldCache 和 X-Cache 则说明异质或结构感知的复用可以保持 rollout 质量。就当前 scaffold 所表示的内容而言，这些工作都没有测量让某个缓存单位变旧后产生的动作与视频联合下游风险，也没有用该测量决定哪些依赖必须刷新。因此，问题是：缺少的操作究竟是不是因果风险分配，而不是又一个相似度分数或固定刷新节奏。

近期 caching 工作让这套测量及时可行。C3ache、WorldCache 和 X-Cache 提供了相关复用参考；DriveCache 是一个边界案例，它已经结合了场景级调度、动作感知响应预算，以及由因果漂移触发的刷新或重规划。因此，CREC 不对所有动作感知的预算式 caching 做宽泛主张。这里的有限问题是：Fast-WAM Optional-IDM 是否存在独特的单位级动作/视频联合风险包络；这种异质性是否可以检验；以及在现有 checkpoint 和 native GPU timing 下，是否能够评估覆盖完整后继的失效处理。

如果这个缺口被补上，Fast-WAM caching 就会得到一个明确的分配对象：在 skip rate 固定时，刷新实证上高风险的尾部，复用其余大部分单位，而不再把局部漂移当成充分依据。动作与视频联合误差以及 closed-loop task success 会成为 cache validity boundary 的一部分。通过检验后，它还可以成为一个可复用的因果诊断，用来判断 latency 下降是否具有机制意义；同时它只是补充已有复用机制，并不声称取代它们。

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: For every cache unit and every changed receding observation in held-out rollouts, replace that unit-timestep with its cached value while keeping the remaining Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph fixed. Record the paired action and predicted-video deviations, indexed by the observation-change level d, against the uncached reference outputs.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This supplies the missing causal intervention: it separates local hidden-state change from the downstream effect of one stale unit.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Aggregate the paired samples into the unit-specific risk envelope `r_u(d)`. Compare the observed distribution across units with a unit-label permutation null that preserves the risk values and change levels. Keep the calibrated envelopes and the pass/fail heterogeneity evidence gate.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: The method needs evidence that risk is genuinely heterogeneous. Without this gate, a global drift rule and the proposed high-risk tail cannot be distinguished by mechanism.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Using the passed risk envelopes, unit costs, dependency graph, and target risk budget or matched skip rate, solve the refresh-versus-reuse selection. Refresh the calibrated high-risk tail and reuse the remaining units, producing unit refresh indicators and a risk-budgeted cache schedule.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: This turns the heterogeneous measurement into the load-bearing cache operation rather than another descriptive cache score.

plain_method_steps_en.what_to_do: Refresh the selected units and invalidate every graph descendant before recomputing the paired action/video outputs. Using matched uncached and control rollouts, measure downstream error, native GPU latency, and task success, and record the envelope-permutation control result.
plain_method_steps_en.why_this_makes_sense: Recomputing all descendants tests the allocation in the actual Fast-WAM graph instead of relying on an isolated intermediate metric.

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 在 held-out rollout 中，针对每个 cache unit 和每个发生变化的 receding observation，把该单位在该时间点替换成缓存值，同时固定其余 Fast-WAM Optional-IDM 计算图。以 uncached reference outputs 为基准，记录动作输出和预测视频输出的联合偏差，并按观测变化幅度 d 编号。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这一步提供缺失的因果干预，把局部隐藏状态变化与某个旧缓存单位造成的下游影响分开。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 把联合偏差样本汇总为单位级风险包络 `r_u(d)`。然后与 unit-label permutation null 比较单位之间的观测分布；置换时保留风险值和变化幅度。保存校准后的风险包络，并给出异质性证据的通过或失败结果。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 方法需要先证明风险确实存在异质性。没有这道门，global drift rule 与提出的高风险尾部在机制上就无法区分。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 使用通过检验的风险包络、unit costs、dependency graph，以及目标 risk budget 或匹配的 skip rate，求解 refresh-versus-reuse 选择。刷新校准后的高风险尾部，复用其余单位，并输出 unit refresh indicators 和 risk-budgeted cache schedule。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 这一步把异质性测量变成方法的核心 caching 操作，而不是另一个只描述缓存的分数。

plain_method_steps_zh.what_to_do: 刷新选中的单位，并在重新计算联合动作/视频输出前让所有图后继失效。使用匹配的 uncached rollout 和 control rollout，测量下游误差、native GPU latency 与 task success，同时记录 envelope-permutation control 的结果。
plain_method_steps_zh.why_this_makes_sense: 重新计算全部后继，可以检验这项分配是否在真实 Fast-WAM 计算图中成立，而不是只改善某个孤立的中间指标。

plain_method_modules_en.purpose_oneline: Set up the existing Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph and obtain per-unit intervention measurements.
Test heterogeneous paired downstream risk and turn the calibrated risk envelope into a refresh allocation.
Apply dependency-complete refresh and evaluate paired error, native latency, task success, and the permutation control.

plain_method_modules_zh.purpose_oneline: 建立现有 Fast-WAM Optional-IDM 计算图，并取得每个单位的干预测量。
检验联合下游风险的异质性，并把校准后的风险包络变成刷新分配。
执行覆盖完整后继的刷新，并评估联合误差、native latency、task success 和置换 control。

falsification_prediction: Run the existing Fast-WAM Optional-IDM checkpoint on held-out LIBERO and RoboTwin receding-observation rollouts, comparing uncached inference, periodic C3ache-style reuse, a global local-drift gate, and the proposed risk-envelope operator at matched skip rates with native GPU timing. If the mechanism is correct, the per-unit envelope r_u(d) will show a non-exchangeable high-risk tail relative to the unit-label permutation null, and the proposed operator will reduce held-out D_joint, action MSE, and predicted-observation MSE relative to the global gate without lowering closed-loop task success. The single load-bearing variable is the unit-specific risk envelope r_u(d); a negative control permutes complete envelopes across cache units while preserving the risk budget, skip rate, and dependency logic, and should increase downstream D_joint and reduce task success rather than merely changing the envelope values. If the heterogeneity test fails or the envelope permutation leaves downstream outcomes unchanged, the claimed causal risk-allocation mechanism is falsified even if a latency reduction remains.
compute_budget: Minimum campaign: 2 A100 GPUs, expandable to 4 for parallel matched arms; approximately 12 A100-GPU-days for calibration replays, native latency profiling, homogeneous/null controls, and held-out LIBERO/RoboTwin evaluation using the existing checkpoint, with no full pretraining; $0 API because all inference and evaluation are local.
what_step_was_missed: C3ache would have needed to replay each cached block-timestep with a stale value while holding the remaining Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph fixed, estimate a per-unit paired action/predicted-observation risk envelope conditioned on the changed receding observation, test whether its risk distribution is genuinely heterogeneous, and solve a downstream error-budgeted refresh problem with descendant recomputation; its fixed cadence and task-success aggregate do not construct any of these causal validity objects.

compute.rationale: API line ≈ $0 vs $10000 (0%) → feasible. Overall (worse line) → feasible.

data.rationale: The existing Fast-WAM Optional-IDM checkpoint can be evaluated on public held-out LIBERO and RoboTwin receding-observation rollouts, with no private data required.

theoretical.rationale: The proposal defines operational risk envelopes and null tests but does not require a new formal theorem or unverified theoretical prerequisite.

engineering.rationale: Per-unit stale-value replays, dependency-complete invalidation, and native GPU timing are implementable but bind the campaign to the existing 2-A100 minimum and up to 4-A100 parallel allocation.

falsification.rationale: The 2-A100 minimum campaign, expandable to 4 A100, has concrete matched-skip controls, a unit-label heterogeneity gate, and an envelope-permutation intervention that can be run with the existing checkpoint and native tooling.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: C3ache reuses same-denoising-step action-expert residuals on a periodic cross-chunk cadence, whereas this candidate causally estimates a unit-specific paired-output risk envelope, protects its empirically tested high-risk tail, and allocates reuse under a downstream error budget with dependency-complete refresh.

EfficientVLA caches attention and MLP intermediates within a CogACT action head from feature similarity, whereas this candidate uses stale-value interventions on Fast-WAM Optional-IDM to estimate receding-observation risk jointly for action and predicted-observation outputs without retraining.

The heterogeneous-token WorldCache uses curvature and accumulated drift to preserve video rollout quality, whereas this candidate's load-bearing object is an empirically calibrated paired action/video downstream-risk envelope whose tail is tested against a homogeneous null and a unit-permutation control.

X-Cache gates autoregressive video-block reuse with structure- and action-aware input fingerprints and KV-update guards, whereas this candidate refreshes Fast-WAM Optional-IDM units from a constrained paired-output error budget and validates the action branch and predicted-observation branch together after receding changes.

OnlineCache learns a policy and an error corrector for diffusion caching, whereas this candidate remains training-free and makes the causal stale-value risk envelope, its heterogeneity null, and its dependency refresh rule the directly testable mechanism.

DriveCache already combines a planned-motion, scene-level dynamic-programming schedule with a calibrated response budget and causal drift-triggered refresh/replan; this candidate instead contributes a per-unit stale-value intervention with a paired action/video downstream-risk envelope, a unit-label heterogeneity test, and dependency-complete descendant invalidation, so action-aware budgeted refresh alone is not claimed as novel.

reviewer_concerns_and_responses.attack: Paper-pointed threat: openalex:W7203663435 (collision_hits). DriveCache reports that cache tolerance varies with ego translation and rotation, denoising progress, and consecutive reuse length, then uses a training-free action-aware controller with dynamic programming under a calibrated response budget and a causal drift-triggered refresh and replan. This directly threatens any broad novelty claim for action-aware budgeted caching with causal refresh. The supplied abstract does not, however, establish the candidate's narrower per-unit stale-value paired action/video envelope, unit-label heterogeneity null, or dependency-complete descendant invalidation, so it does not establish exact-mechanism overlap; the candidate must explicitly contrast these objects before claiming novelty.
reviewer_concerns_and_responses.response: DriveCache is explicitly treated as the closest collision: its scene-level dynamic-programming controller already combines an action-aware response budget with causal drift-triggered refresh and replan. The bounded claim in `hook`, `falsification_prediction`, and `differentiation_from_lit` is narrower—stale-value, per-unit paired action/video risk envelopes, a unit-label heterogeneity gate, and dependency-complete descendant invalidation—so the Phase 3.2 rationale blocks broad novelty for action-aware budgeted caching but does not establish exact-mechanism overlap.

domain_landscape.position_note: The candidate's `reframe_as_solvable_object` pattern is mid-frequency in this landscape, while architectural operator substitution is saturated; its distinctive placement is to make the risk envelope and heterogeneity gate the testable object around existing caching machinery.
